name: i18n-drift-audit
description: Weekly i18n drift audit (I18N-08): surfaces ratchet baseline movement, per-locale translation-coverage regression, and unused-key accumulation. Not a gate — pnpm check -- --only i18n and pnpm check -- --only catalogs remain the enforcement paths (see knowledge/product/governance/kyberion-development-practices.md); this pipeline makes their weekly trend visible in one report and alerts on translation-coverage regression.
